papers.title: Beyond English: Uncovering the Multilingual Gap in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.what: First systematic multilingual test for VLA models: translating LIBERO and SimplerEnv into four languages shows relative task success drops by about 28 to 47 points (up to 65 to 76 for weaker action heads) even with a multilingual backbone, and a principal-component alignment method (MPCA) recovers part of the gap.

papers.title: Infini Memory: Maintainable Topic Documents for Long-Term LLM Agent Memory
papers.what: Stores agent long-term memory as topic-structured, revisable text documents instead of a flat log or vector store, keeping facts consistent and current across long tasks.

papers.title: MemToolAgent: Leveraging Memory for Tool-Using Agents Based on Environment and User Feedback
papers.what: Adds an extract-then-retrieve memory loop to a tool-using agent so tool choices are informed by past outcomes and feedback, reducing repeated tool-use mistakes across multi-turn interactions.

papers.title: Uncertainty Quantification for Flow-Based Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.what: Adds confidence estimates and unreliability flags to a flow-matching action head, giving an out-of-distribution and low-confidence detector for flow-based action models.
